materials_scope: Actual user prompts and implementation/verification records from the 2026-11-09 MiniVectorDB work session. Agent explanations are labeled as agent output, not as student understanding. No hidden reasoning, credentials or external test data are included.

user_prompts.content: 你来做最新的轻向量数据库的第一题，分支应该还是2026-competition那个分支，题包你自己找找

conversations.content: The public Yuque statement and the oceanbase/seekdb 2026-competition-round2 branch were located. The branch contains mysqltest/README.md, manifest.json and 20 public cases; Dockerfile and conversation.json were empty placeholders. The submission branch is 2026-competition-round2, not the earlier 2026-competition baseline.

The public package does not contain the official stdin/stdout driver. Two OceanBase forum threads created on 2026-11-09 (topics 35653823 and 35653825) ask for the same ready marker, result format, statement boundary, error mapping, exact/ann switch and precheck entry. No official protocol answer was present when checked. A one-line JSON transport was isolated as an interim local adapter rather than represented as the official protocol.

Implementation chosen: dependency-free Rust; CRC32-framed WAL with fsync before success; atomic meta rename for checkpoints; private transaction overlays for statement atomicity and rollback; float32 vector storage; exact filtered TopK with primary-key tie breaking; bounded vector cache with durable reload.

experiments.output: PASS sql_crud; PASS sql_comparisons; PASS sql_ordering; PASS sql_empty; PASS sql_primary_key; PASS sql_unicode; PASS sql_bigint; PASS sql_unsupported; PASS storage_restart; PASS vector_euclidean; PASS transaction_commit; PASS transaction_rollback; PASS storage_mutations; PASS storage_multiple_tables; PASS vector_ties_and_filter; PASS vector_float32; PASS vector_index_maintenance; PASS transaction_failed_insert; PASS transaction_autocommit_atomic; PASS transaction_shutdown_rollback. 20/20 public cases passed.

experiments.command: MINIVEC_CHECKPOINT_MIN_BYTES=1 MINIVEC_CHECKPOINT_LIVE_FACTOR=0 MINIVEC_VECTOR_ARENA_MB=0 python3 -I tools/run_public_tests.py --binary target/debug/minivectordb --manifest mysqltest/manifest.json
experiments.output: 20/20 public cases passed with checkpoints forced after commits and all cached vectors evicted. This exercised durable vector reload, checkpoint generation changes and restart recovery rather than only the in-memory path.

PASS validation_test; PASS transaction_test; PASS crash_test; PASS random_topk_test. 4/4 extended test groups passed. The tests reject NaN/Infinity/float32 overflow/wrong dimensions, verify i64::MIN, transactional DDL rollback, SIGKILL and repeated recovery, torn WAL truncation, and random exact/ANN filtered TopK against independently computed Python brute-force truth.

retrospective.content: The initial exact query implementation cloned every visible row and fully sorted candidates. It was changed to borrowed row visibility plus a bounded max-heap for ascending distance TopK. All public and extended tests were rerun after the change. The later float32 accumulator is restricted to ANN mode; exact mode retains float64 accumulation.

A memory review found that checkpointing initially materialized every evicted vector before writing. Checkpoint serialization was changed to materialize one row at a time, and checkpoint startup chooses uncached vector loading when the generation exceeds the arena budget. Forced-checkpoint and zero-arena tests passed after this correction.

limitations: The official evaluation wire protocol and frozen resource/error mapping were not available in the public branch when this material was recorded. The local JSON transport is not claimed to be official; formal submission requires adapting it to the published driver.
ANN currently scans all visible candidates with float32 distance accumulation and does not use IVF/HNSW pruning. Recall is favored over index speedup; no platform rank or score is claimed.
Only the two short student prompts above are present. Agent design explanations and test output are not represented as independent student understanding or student-originated verification.
